task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-04a at src/design/adp-04a-external-identity-linkage-user.md. Define additive user schema updates for external identity linkage: external_id TEXT NULL (OIDC sub), external_realm TEXT NULL (realm/issuer), auth_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'internal' with allowed values internal|oidc, and a unique index over (external_realm, external_id). Specify migration/backfill semantics ensuring all existing users remain internal with NULL externals, and define repository/service lookup contracts for realm+sub resolution used by JIT provisioning while preserving IDN-01 internal-user behavior. Include constraints for uniqueness, NULL handling, and boundaries that prevent cross-tenant identity collisions. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines additive ADP-04a schema columns and unique index semantics with backward compatibility
Migration/backfill behavior for pre-existing users is explicit and testable
Identity repository/service contracts for (external_realm, external_id) lookup are implementation-ready
Uniqueness and NULL-handling rules are fully specified for internal vs OIDC users
Traceability maps ADP-04a behavior to IDN-01, OIDC-09, and OIDC-11

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-04a external identity linkage on user with additive schema semantics, migration/backfill compatibility, and realm+sub identity contracts for JIT provisioning.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2) for migration and identity implementation.
